recent.text: Jaylen Brown: “I felt good. I felt fine. I felt athletic.” Says the two early fouls made it hard for him to find a rhythm. Asked about Jayson Tatum trying to greet him pregame, he said he is just trying to focus on helping his team win. “Credit to Jayson. Credit to the Celtics.”
recent.author: Adam Aaronson

recent.text: As if Jayson Tatum thoroughly outplaying Jaylen Brown wasn’t enough, Paul George outdid them both – just like last season’s playoffs. Story on Brown struggling against Tatum and George stealing the show as the Celtics buried the Sixers with threes: https://t.co/SGMYgHff6n
